pokedexEntries.rb: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

pokedexEntries.ye: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

pokedexEntries.go: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

pokedexEntries.si: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.

pokedexEntries.cr: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

pokedexEntries.rs: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

pokedexEntries.em: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

pokedexEntries.hg: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

pokedexEntries.ss: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.

pokedexEntries.bw: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

pokedexEntries.oras: At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

pokedexEntries.su: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon’s tongue is always hanging out. It uses its tongue with great dexterity to dig up sand from the seabed in its search for food.

pokedexEntries.us: The sand that accumulates inside its shell eventually becomes a pearl. But the pearl gets in the way, so it spits it out and discards it.

pokedexEntries.um: Even when its shell is closed, its tongue still hangs out. If you give its tongue a good yank, the shock will cause Shellder to open its shell.
